> ⚠️ 这是基于上游 `skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced` v1.3.8 的非官方分支构建，不是官方发布。问题请先在本分支反馈，不要打扰上游。
> This is an unofficial fork build based on upstream `skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced` v1.3.8. It is not an official release — please report issues against this fork rather than upstream.

### Highlights | 更新内容

- 修复了非 HDR 串流画面偏暗的问题。Native 渲染器此前会把 SDR 画面标记为 BT.709，导致系统多做了一次 ~2.4 → ~2.2 的传输函数转换。以纯色 `#808080` 实测：主机端为 `128`，修复前显示为 `121`，修复后为 `128`，与官方 moonlight-qt 的 `129` 一致。
  Fixed SDR streams rendering darker than they should. The Native renderer tagged SDR buffers as BT.709, which made the system apply a ~2.4 → ~2.2 transfer conversion the content never needed. Measured with a solid `#808080` patch: the host shows `128`, this rendered as `121` before the fix and `128` after, matching upstream moonlight-qt's `129`.

- 修复了应用无法发现或连接局域网主机的问题。此前发布的安装包完全没有代码签名，macOS 26+ 因此无法为其保存“本地网络”授权，mDNS 自动发现与手动输入 IP 连接都会被静默拦截。现在构建产物带有有效的 ad-hoc 签名，授权可以正常保存。
  Fixed the app being unable to discover or connect to hosts on the local network. Previous release packages shipped with no code signature at all, so macOS 26+ could not persist a Local Network grant — silently blocking both mDNS discovery and manual IP connections. Builds are now validly ad-hoc signed, so the permission sticks.

- 界面中此前硬编码为中文的 143 条文案现已接入本地化层，英文界面下会正确显示英文。涉及串流右键菜单、诊断浮层、连接编辑器、设置日志面板与麦克风授权提示。中文显示不受影响。
  143 user-facing strings that were hardcoded in Chinese now go through the localization layer, so they display in English when the app language is English. This covers the in-stream context menu, diagnostics overlay, connection editor, settings log pane, and microphone authorization messages. Chinese output is unchanged.

### Maintenance | 维护更新

- 构建流程现在会实际执行代码签名，并在 CI 中校验签名有效性，避免再次发布未签名、无法保存系统授权的安装包。
  The build pipeline now actually performs code signing and verifies the signature in CI, so an unsigned bundle that cannot hold system permissions can no longer ship unnoticed.

- 关闭了 Hardened Runtime。ad-hoc 签名无法满足 library validation，启用后 dyld 会拒绝加载随包分发的 SDL2 / OpenSSL framework 并在启动时崩溃。
  Disabled the hardened runtime. Ad-hoc signed code cannot satisfy library validation, so enabling it made dyld refuse to load the bundled SDL2 / OpenSSL frameworks and the app aborted at launch.
